conventions: Population SD; quantiles linear at (n-1)p; counts are at-or-above 60/70/80/90 and strictly below 40/30; ties counted on exact, one-decimal (Units board) and whole-point (tables/matchups) values. Theoretical bounds: current-rank live 0/100; 32-team historical CDF 1.5625/98.4375; 448-window CDF 0.1116/99.8884 (two teams use 3-game windows); priors 15/85 from regressing 0..100 sources.
